changes.text: 一群在美国读书的中国朋友，为中国文学该怎样改革争论了一年多。1916年7月，湖上一场几乎翻船的风雨，和一位朋友用老字写成的纪事诗，又掀起一轮新的争吵，争论最后收缩到一个问题上：诗能不能用白话写。站在一边的是胡适，而他一向说自己是保守的人，认为语言文字是世界上最保守的东西，比宗教还保守，还说自己这一路是被「逼上梁山」的。这句成语说的是一个人为环境所迫，不得已而做出违反他本意的非常行为。

A group of Chinese friends studying in America argued for more than a year over how Chinese literature should change. In July 1916 a storm on a lake that nearly capsized their boat, and a friend's poem about it written in archaic words, set off a fresh round of quarrelling, and the dispute finally narrowed to one question: could poetry be written in baihua, the everyday spoken language? On one side stood Hu Shi, who called himself a conservative: language and writing, he liked to say, are the most conservative things in the world, more conservative than religion. He also said he had been pushed down this road: bi shang Liangshan, driven to Liangshan, an idiom for someone forced by circumstances into extraordinary acts against his own intentions.

反对他的主要是两位朋友：一位是去哈佛升学、最坚定的反对者梅光迪，另一位是同在康乃尔、写诗嘲笑过他的任鸿隽。争的是白话能不能用来写文学。到1916年夏天，朋友们已承认白话可以写小说、演说，唯独不肯承认它能作诗，反对者已经退到只剩一处：诗。按胡适的说法，难处在于从来没有中国作家认真着实用白话作诗，他在中国诗词中能找到的白话诗只有一首，甚至只是一首中的几句。按他自己的说法，这许多严肃的讨论都只源于一首送别诗引起的小小偶然事件；让他下定决心不写旧诗、要写就用活的语言来写的，则是又一件偶然发生的小事——湖上那场险事。

His chief opponents were two friends: Mei Guangdi, bound for Harvard and his most determined opponent, and Ren Hongjun, also at Cornell, who had mocked him in verse. The quarrel was over whether the vernacular could serve literature. By the summer of 1916 his friends granted that it would do for fiction and speeches, but not for poetry. Poetry was the last fortress. The difficulty, as Hu saw it, was that no Chinese writer had ever seriously written poetry in the vernacular; in all of Chinese verse he could find only one such poem, perhaps only a few lines of one. In his own telling, all the serious discussion grew out of a small accident set off by a farewell poem; what made him resolve to stop writing old-style verse and write only in the living language was another small accident, the incident on the lake.

dispositions.rationale: Hook.0 now opens with more than a year of argument over how Chinese literature should change. Only after the July 1916 lake incident does it say the dispute narrowed to whether poetry could be written in the vernacular, so the result is no longer presented as the starting point. The English is updated to match.

evidence.quote: 我们一年多的讨论已逐渐约束到一个中心议题里来
愈辩则牵涉愈多，内容也愈复杂愈精湛

dispositions.rationale: Hook.1's last sentence now keeps two attributions apart. Hu says the farewell poem gave rise to the serious discussions. He says his resolve to stop writing old-style poetry came from another small accident, the lake incident. HS-E38 is added to ev, and the English is updated to match.

evidence.quote: 这许多严肃性的讨论，和我后来所做的历史性的研析，实在只是由于我写了一首向去哈佛升学朋友的送别诗所引起的小小偶然事件
其结果竟使我下定决心不写旧诗，要写就用活的语言来写
